ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: OGRE Vulkan render system plugin, Wayland flavour
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The sources of OgreRenderSystem_Vulkan (the directory Vulkan) built for Wayland (VK_USE_PLATFORM_WAYLAND_KHR, the equivalent of the upstream option OGRE_USE_WAYLAND), so that its render windows are made on a wl_surface of a Wayland window (externalWlDisplay, externalWlSurface). An application on Wayland lists this plugin instead of OgreRenderSystem_Vulkan; the render system has the same name. The module lists the sources of the other directory in its ProjectGenInstructions.xml.
